title: Dashboard
description: The declarative manifest of an elbi dashboard: a presentation surface whose widgets each bind to a certified derivation. A dashboard holds no data logic of its own; it names derivations, resolves parameters, and lays out how their verified results are rendered. This is the open standard; implementations load this schema as data and validate against it rather than mirroring it in code.

specVersion.description: The version of the Dashboard Spec this manifest conforms to.

kind.description: The manifest kind. Always 'Dashboard' for this schema.

name.description: A stable, unique identifier for the dashboard. Lower snake_case.

title.description: Human-readable dashboard title shown in the UI.

description.description: Human- and agent-readable summary of what the dashboard shows.

theme.description: Rendering theme. 'auto' follows the viewer's preference.

variables.description: Dashboard-scoped values a viewer supplies through filter controls. A widget consumes a variable by referencing it as '$name' in its bind params, so wiring is explicit and reviewable.

pages.description: The dashboard's pages. Each page is a grid of widgets.

refresh.description: How often a viewer's browser re-checks each widget's data version for staleness.

name.description: The variable's identifier, referenced by widgets as '$name'.

label.description: Display label for the filter control. Defaults to a title-cased name.

type.description: The value type a selection produces. A 'multiselect' control produces an array of this type; 'daterange' produces a two-element [start, end] array of dates.

control.description: The input control rendered for this variable.

default.description: Initial value when the viewer has made no selection.

scope.description: 'global' (all pages) or the name of a single page this filter is confined to.

appliesTo.description: Which widgets this variable filters when applied by cross-filtering: '*' for all in scope, or an explicit list of widget ids. Advisory to the renderer; a widget always consumes a variable it references via '$name'.

immune.description: Widget ids that cross-filtering never touches, even when in 'appliesTo'.

options.description: Where a control's selectable options come from: a static list, or the distinct values of a column produced by a certified derivation.

derivation.description: A certified derivation whose rows supply the option values.

column.description: The column whose distinct values become option values.

labelColumn.description: Optional column supplying a human-readable label per value.

columns.description: Number of grid columns the page is divided into.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the dashboard.

type.description: The kind of widget. 'metric', 'chart', 'map', and 'table' bind to a derivation; 'text' renders markdown; 'filter' renders a control for a variable.

viz.description: Rendering spec for the widget. For 'chart'/'map' this is a grammar-of-graphics spec; for 'metric' it selects the field and format; for 'table' it configures columns and paging.

content.description: Markdown body for a 'text' widget. Supports '$name' variable interpolation.

variable.description: For a 'filter' widget, the name of the variable this control binds.

gridPos.description: Grid placement. The page is divided into 'columns' columns; each height unit is one grid row.

bind.description: The data binding: either a certified derivation (with params) or a semantic-layer metric (with groupBy, grain, and filters). A param value is a literal or a '$name' reference to a dashboard variable. Exactly one of 'derivation' or 'metric' is set.

metric.description: The semantic-layer metric this tile resolves.

groupBy.description: Dimensions to group the metric by.

grain.description: Time grain to roll the metric up to.

crossFilter.description: On selecting a mark, set dashboard variables from the selected datum, re-resolving every non-immune widget that references them.

emit.description: Map of variable name to the datum field whose value is emitted on selection.

drillThrough.description: On selection, navigate to a detail page or dashboard, carrying variable state.

target.description: 'page:<name>' for a page in this dashboard, or 'dashboard:<name>' for another dashboard.

carry.description: Variable names whose current values are carried to the target.

drillDown.description: Step through a hierarchy of grouping columns within the widget by rebinding a param.

param.description: The bind param set to the current hierarchy level.
